note: Forbidden: a body other than one <AFI, SAFI> in 32 bits (AFI 16, Res 8, SAFI 8). TestRouteRefreshPack asserts Len(data) == HeaderLen+4 and each of the four body bytes, red on a wrong size or layout. TestHandleRouteRefresh_InvalidLength asserts ErrInvalidMessage for 3-, 5- and 0-byte bodies, and TestRouteRefreshUnpackShort asserts ErrShortRead for 3 bytes, red if a body of another length is accepted.
